title: Cobblemon Depths
description: The modpack used by AxeTheShadow and friends on YouTube and Twitch
body:
Adventure across custom terrain with your friends as you catch them all!! Spend time exploring ancient temples and other dimensions in search of legendary Pokémon! With backpacks to expand your inventory and custom blocks and furniture to make your dream builds, turn the world into your own!

From adventuring the world and building fancy towns, to battling your friends to become the very best! The possibilities are near limitless! 
 
 
 
The pack includes two datapacks that I made to make items from different mods craftable. Both datapacks are available on their own through my page, or through these links:
- [Saro's Player Plushie Recipe](https://modrinth.com/datapack/saros-player-plushie-recipe)
- [Growth Essence Recipe](https://modrinth.com/datapack/growth-essence-recipe)

I hope you enjoy this pack, as my friends and I have been enjoying it so far. This is not the first page my friends and I have made or done content with. So I encourage you to check out my page for other packs and projects. I also encourage you to check out our channels below to see our experience with this pack, and have an idea when new packs come out!
